title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in the Menu component (@progress/kendo-react-layout) in Progress Software KendoReact…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Menu component of Progress Software KendoReact versions 1.3.0 through 16.1.0. This flaw allows a low-privileged attacker who can influence Menu item data to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the affected application when a user selects a malicious Menu item URL.
